sourceConclusions: Untrusted MAIN support/resistance prices remain a separate bounded candidate side channel with UNVERIFIED semantics. Missing, malformed and explicit empty observations remain distinguishable; no inferred absence, coordinates or authority is restored.
At least three numeric OCR/grid ticks establish the linear axis; two exact widely separated MAIN numeric prices only corroborate magnitude. Legacy three-model-match policy is unchanged and separate.
Exact independent crop, confidence, numeric parsing, row association, monotonicity, coverage, 1.5-pixel fit and no-extrapolation requirements are preserved. Canvas x/y rounding uses actual scales.

Placement rechecks retained words, current measured region, candidate numeric readings, anchors and residual; changing a bare verified flag is insufficient. Geometric consistency does not authenticate image origin; that remains the owning hook responsibility.
Cancellation, deadline and cleanup logic is explicit. This review inspected those paths but did not run a real browser cancellation/timeout assay; eventual lifecycle tests remain separate.
integrationRequirements: Collect candidates on completed MAIN before merge/calibration and attach the locally collected result after processing; overwrite or ignore any model-supplied field with the same name.

Compute detector evidence from the current original image and bind image/report/confirmation identity and epoch throughout the owning hook, including same-dimension image changes and A-B-A/reconfirmation transitions.
Keep explicit log/nonlinear/unknown-scale warnings held; do not allow independent horizontal placement to enable pattern/liquidity or promote model semantics.

Actual retained d001 OCR and unchanged one-pixel scoring are still pending and must be reported separately. One-pixel semantic accuracy, broad generalization, held-out performance and production readiness are not accepted here.
